title: calotropis syriaca
intro: Calotropis syriaca, commonly known as the Syrian oak, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calotropis syriaca include its use in treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents present in Calotropis syriaca have been found to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
